title: Gradient Maker
description: Design CSS gradients visually — linear, radial or conic — with 3 color stops, angle control, live preview and copyable code.
howto: Pick three colors using the color pickers.
Choose linear, radial or conic type and set the angle.
Copy the generated CSS gradient code for your project.

faqs.a: Linear (directional), radial (circular/elliptical from a center) and conic (sweeping around a center point).
Standard CSS like linear-gradient(135deg, #ff0000 0%, #00ff00 50%, #0000ff 100%), ready to paste into any stylesheet.

faqs.q: Are the color stops evenly spaced?
faqs.a: Yes — the three stops sit at 0%, 50% and 100% for a balanced blend. For custom stop positions, adjust the code manually.
